goal: Produce the canonical, numerically-proven LLM reference for sketch.preTrim — STEP 1 of preTrim->trim->postTrim. Document what is preTrim-SPECIFIC vs inherited from the shared split engine (splitCurve.md): (1) auto-computed mutual-intersection split points landing EXACTLY on analytic coordinates (line-line, line-circle, circle-circle, tangent, T-junction); (2) the STAGING model (SplittedCurves/NoneSplitted CC_Container nodes, original ids PRESERVED as copies — the opposite of splitCurve which destroys the source); (3) curveIds subset/omitted/empty semantics and NoneSplitted preservation; (4) the full preTrim->trim->postTrim round-trip including postTrim id behavior (clean restore vs trimmed-survivor new ids, Auto_Coinc, coalescing); (5) edge/degenerate (no-intersection [0,1], empty sketch [], overlaps, construction/rigidSet passthrough) and error/identity codes. Do NOT re-prove generic split-engine basics nailed in splitCurve.md (result shape, 1004/1006/1001 codes, solver independence of geometry) — cite it and spend the budget on preTrim-specific behavior.
questions: Does preTrim return the exact same structured shape as splitCurve (Array<{sourceId, splittedCurves:[{id,interval}]}>), one entry per input curve in input order? (Inherited — cite splitCurve.md, confirm only in smoke.)

Do auto-computed splits land EXACTLY on analytic intersection coords for line-line (50,50,0), skew (40,20,0), line-circle (+/-50,0,0), circle-circle (30,+/-40,0), and tangent (0,50,0)? Numeric proof via getPositions.
Open curve crossed N times -> N+1 segments; closed circle crossed twice -> 2 arcs (N not N+1); tangent-once circle -> 1 whole-circle part with a length-1 wrapped interval (NOT [0,1])?
Are circle arc-part intervals turn-fractions from +X CCW that can go negative / wrap for the seam-straddling arc, asymmetric per circle?
Does a singly-tangent circle part fail getPositions (closed-circle rule, mL51) requiring getPoints->centerId, while open-arc parts support getPositions?
Does preTrim PRESERVE original curve ids (stage copies into SplittedCurves) rather than destroy them like splitCurve? Original id alive (mL31) mid-workflow via getPositions/getGeometry?
What staging containers appear after preTrim — exact class (CC_Container) and names (SplittedCurves, NoneSplitted), identified by NAME not id (ids vary run-to-run)? Both removed by postTrim?
Does getGeometry mid-workflow report ONLY original ids (staged segment ids invisible), making it useless for enumerating trim targets — must drive off preTrim.result?
curveIds: result.length === curveIds.length on success; excluded curves absent from result, parked in NoneSplitted (parent flips to container), preserved through the whole round-trip untouched?
curveIds excluded curve: does it still act as a CUTTER for the included subset, or is it fully ignored (not even a cutter)?
curveIds edge values: single id -> success no split (no partner); empty array [] -> treated as ALL (NOT none) — the empty-array trap?
Full round-trip: preTrim -> trim(remove segs) -> postTrim yields correct final geometry (L-profile from crossed lines). What ids do survivors get?

postTrim id semantics: no-trim postTrim = clean restore preserving ORIGINAL ids; trim then postTrim = trimmed-curve survivors get NEW ids while UNtrimmed participants keep original ids; trim([]) empty forces id-recreate path?
Does postTrim auto-create Auto_Coinc (CC_2DCoincidentConstraint) at the cut vertex and recreate Auto_H/Auto_V constraints with new ids (re-fetch by NAME)?
Do contiguous surviving segments of the same source coalesce into ONE curve on postTrim?

trim semantics: atomic fail on bogus id (mL51 code 1006, nothing trimmed); SILENT no-op when passed an ORIGINAL sourceId instead of a staged segment id (mL31, removes nothing) — contradicting SKETCHING; multiple trim() before one postTrim supported?
No-intersection / single curve / empty sketch: single [0,1] part with id===sourceId; empty sketch -> result:[] (NOT VOID/error); staging containers still created on empty?
Identity probe: id===sourceId && interval==[0,1] reliably means 'this curve was NOT split'? Split curves get NEW ids with sourceId=original.
Endpoint-touching vs crossing: T-junction (endpoint on midline) splits the through-curve only; shared corner / collinear tip-to-tip -> neither splits; only OPEN-interior (0<t<1) intersections cut?

Degenerate overlaps: identical fully-overlapping lines -> both [0,1] undetected (silent); partial collinear overlap -> each splits at the other's interior endpoint, DUPLICATING the overlap segment (silent hazard)?
3-4 curves through one point -> each splits into exactly 2, no spurious slivers (dedup of shared point)?

Construction line and rigidSet member: appear as [0,1] passthrough (id===sourceId), NOT split, NO error — but DO act as cutters for normal curves? (rigidSet: splitCurve errors mL51, preTrim is silent — contrast.)

preTrim twice without postTrim: silent overwrite (mL31), first batch of segment ids DIES (mL51), SplittedCurves child count does NOT accumulate? Does it leak an empty NoneSplitted0 container postTrim doesn't clean?

Error/identity codes (preTrim-applied): missing id->1004; nonexistent id->41+1006; part/plane id->1001 expects ['sketch']; bad/wrong-type curveIds element->1006/1001 expects ['sketch-curve']; one bad element atomic-fails whole call; result is VOID (Array.isArray guard)?
Solver independence: does preTrim work identically on a PLANELESS sketch (split AND the staging/restore round-trip), mL31?
Out-of-order calls: postTrim with nothing staged -> harmless no-op mL31; trim with nothing staged -> silent no-op mL31?
Duplicate ids in curveIds ([L1,L1,L2]) -> NOT de-duplicated, produces duplicate result entries (L1 split independently twice)?
setupNotes: Harness: export default async function (api, { snapshot, filewrite }) { ... } returning the full envelope { result, messages, maxLevel, structure, graphic }. ONE part.create per run (2nd returns VOID) — build multi-case scripts as ONE part + many sketches via the setup helper. Setup helper at /Users/dev/dev/awv/classcad-agent/workspace/training/2026-06-30_12-44-12_sketch-preTrim/scripts/_setup.mjs exports: makeSketch(api)->{partId,skId,planeId} (Top plane, solver-enabled), addSketch(api,partId,planeId,name), addPlanelessSketch(api,partId,name), line(api,skId,a,b), positions(api,id)->{startPos,endPos,pos,maxLevel}, approx/vecApprox, summarizeSplit(r), firstError(r). Z MUST be 0. getPositions works on line/arc ids, FAILS on circle ids (mL51) — use getPoints->centerId for whole-circle parts. maxLevel: <=31 success, 41-50 warning, >=51 error. On any preTrim error result is VOID — guard with Array.isArray(r.result). Container ids vary run-to-run — find SplittedCurves/NoneSplitted by NAME in structure.tree (class CC_Container). rigidSet via api.v1.sketch.rigidSet({ id:skId, geomIds:[a,b] }). Construction line via isConstruction:true on the line call. The five analyst lenses ALREADY RAN scripts 00,10-15,wf01-wf05 producing all the numbers cited here; these matrix scripts are the de-duplicated, ordered re-run set for the canonical doc — reuse existing script logic where it maps 1:1. Spatial claims need NUMERIC proof (getPositions/getPoints), never snapshots alone (SOUL.md). Cite splitCurve.md for inherited facts; do NOT re-prove result shape, code semantics, or geometry solver-independence beyond a single confirming smoke.

scripts.call: const pre = await api.v1.sketch.preTrim({ id: skId }); const geoBefore=geo earlier; const geoAfter=await api.v1.sketch.getGeometry({id:skId}); scan structure.tree for class==='CC_Container'.

scripts.title: Line-line cross at (50,50,0) and skew cross at (40,20,0) land EXACTLY on analytic intersection
scripts.question: Do auto-computed splits land on the exact analytic intersection coordinate (~1e-14) for an axis-symmetric cross AND a skew cross (proving true 2D chord-lerp, not axis luck)?
scripts.call: preTrim each sketch; getPositions on the shared cut vertex of each split pair (seg[0].endPos).
scripts.expected: A: both split at interval 0.5, shared vertex reads (50,50,0) to ~1e-14. B: both split at 0.5, vertex reads (40,20,0) exactly. Confirms exact true-2D intersection finder.

scripts.title: Line through circle: 3 line segments + 2 circle arcs, endpoints at (-50,0,0),(+50,0,0)
scripts.question: Open line crossing a circle twice -> N+1=3 line segments cut at (+/-50,0,0); circle -> 2 arcs (N, not N+1) with arc endpoints on the same two points; do arc-part ids support getPositions?
scripts.setup: makeSketch; circle c=(0,0,0) r=50 (getPoints->centerId for the circle id); line (-100,0,0)->(100,0,0).
scripts.call: preTrim; getPositions on the 3 line segs and the 2 arc segs.
scripts.expected: Line entry: 3 segs intervals [0,0.25],[0.25,0.75],[0.75,1], cut vertices exactly (-50,0,0) and (+50,0,0). Circle entry: 2 arc segs (getPositions WORKS on arc ids), endpoints land at (+/-50,~0,0). Confirms open=N+1, closed-crossed-twice=2 arcs.
scripts.measurement: line seg count + cut coords; circle arc count; arc endpoint coords via getPositions

scripts.title: Circle-circle: each circle -> 2 arcs at (30,+/-40,0); intervals are turn-fractions, can go negative/wrap
scripts.question: Two circles intersecting at 2 points -> each splits into 2 arcs with endpoints exactly (30,+/-40,0); are intervals turn-fractions from +X CCW that go NEGATIVE for the seam-straddling arc and are ASYMMETRIC per circle (NOT [0,0.5] halves)?
scripts.setup: makeSketch; C1 (0,0,0) r50, C2 (60,0,0) r50; analytic intersections (30,40,0),(30,-40,0).
scripts.call: preTrim; getPositions on all 4 arc segs; record their intervals.
scripts.expected: Each circle -> 2 arcs, endpoints read (30,+/-40,0) exactly. Intervals e.g. C1 [-0.1464,0.1464] & [0.1464,0.8536]; C2 [-0.3536,0.3536] & [0.3536,0.6464] — negative-start for seam straddler, halves differ per circle. Never infer arc endpoints from interval — read getPositions.
scripts.measurement: arc endpoint coords; the 4 interval pairs (note sign + asymmetry)

scripts.title: Tangent line-circle at (0,50,0): line SPLITS, circle stays ONE whole-circle part with wrapped interval, getPositions fails
scripts.question: Single tangent contact: does the OPEN line still split at (0,50,0) (2 segs), while the circle stays ONE part with interval a length-1 window centered on the contact param (NOT [0,1]) that is a CLOSED circle (getPoints->centerId, getPositions mL51)?

scripts.expected: Line: 2 segs [0,0.5],[0.5,1], shared vertex (0,50,0) exact. Circle: 1 part interval ~[-0.75,0.25] (span 1.0 = whole loop, centered on tangent param 0.25); getPositions FAILS mL51; getPoints returns centerId at (0,0,0). Caller hazard: single splittedCurve is NOT automatically [0,1].

scripts.title: curveIds subset: result.length==curveIds.length, excluded curve absent from result and parked in NoneSplitted
scripts.question: With curveIds=[L1,L2] on a 3-line sketch (L3 excluded but geometrically crossing): is result length 2, L3 absent from result, L3 NOT split (parent flips to NoneSplitted container), and the subset split exactly at their mutual crossing?

scripts.title: Excluded curve does NOT act as cutter; single-id and empty-array curveIds edge semantics
scripts.question: Does an excluded curve fail to cut even included curves it crosses? Single-id curveIds -> success no split? Empty array [] -> treated as ALL (the empty-array trap), NOT none?

B: 1 entry single [0,1] no split (no partner), both listed/unlisted curves land NoneSplitted. C: empty [] behaves as ALL — both lines split (2 entries, SplittedCurves populated). Empty array != skip.

scripts.title: postTrim id semantics: no-trim = clean restore (original ids); trim+postTrim = trimmed survivors NEW ids, untrimmed keep original; trim([]) forces recreate
scripts.question: Three postTrim paths: (a) no trim() -> original ids preserved byte-identical; (b) trim(real seg)+postTrim -> trimmed curve survivor NEW id, untrimmed participant keeps ORIGINAL id; (c) trim([]) empty -> still routes recreate path (ids change)?
scripts.setup: makeSketch sketch A: 2 crossed lines, preTrim then postTrim (no trim). addSketch B: 2 crossed lines, preTrim, trim one half of one line, postTrim. addSketch C: 2 crossed lines, preTrim, trim([]), postTrim.
scripts.call: Run the three paths; getGeometry + getPositions before/after each.

C: trim([]) no-op geometrically but survivors come back with NEW ids (recreate path). So 'all ids change on postTrim' is too strong — only trimmed curves churn.

scripts.title: trim footguns: atomic fail on bogus id (1006, nothing trimmed); SILENT no-op on original sourceId; multiple trim() before one postTrim
scripts.question: Does trim atomic-fail (mL51 1006) on a bogus id leaving the valid seg intact; SILENTLY no-op (mL31, removes nothing) when passed an ORIGINAL sourceId instead of a staged seg id (contradicting SKETCHING); and support multiple trim() calls before one postTrim?

scripts.call: A: trim({curveIds:[validSeg, 999999]}); then postTrim, check survivors. B: trim({curveIds:[originalLineId]}); postTrim, check both lines survive. C: two separate trim() calls each removing a different end seg; postTrim.
scripts.expected: A: mL51 code 1006 'invalid id' + a level-41 ToId warning; the valid seg NOT trimmed (atomic); postTrim recovers. B: mL31 NO error, removes NOTHING — both originals intact after postTrim (FOOTGUN, contradicts SKETCHING 'trim only accepts segment ids'). C: incremental trims work; final survivor = the un-trimmed middle seg, exact coords.
scripts.measurement: A maxLevel+code, survivor presence; B maxLevel + both lines alive; C final survivor coords

scripts.title: No-intersection [0,1] with id===sourceId; empty sketch -> result:[]; single curve success; identity probe

scripts.call: preTrim each; check splittedCurves[0].id vs sourceId; check result type on empty; scan tree for containers on empty.
scripts.expected: A: each entry single [0,1], id===sourceId, positions = original endpoints, mL31. B: 1 entry single [0,1] id unchanged (preTrim does NOT require >=2 curves). C: result===[] (Array, empty — NOT null/VOID), messages [], mL31, and SplittedCurves/NoneSplitted containers STILL created. Rule: id===sourceId && interval==[0,1] => curve was NOT split.
scripts.measurement: id===sourceId boolean per case; empty result Array.isArray + length 0; containers on empty

scripts.title: T-junction splits through-curve only; shared corner / collinear tip-to-tip -> neither splits (only open-interior cuts)
scripts.question: Does an intersection cut a curve ONLY when it lands in that curve's open interior (0<t<1)? T-junction: through-line splits, touching line [0,1] with id reused. Shared corner and collinear tip-to-tip: neither splits.
scripts.setup: makeSketch sketch A (T): L1 (0,0,0)->(100,0,0); L2 (50,0,0)->(50,80,0), L2 start on L1 interior. addSketch B (corner): both lines start at same point. addSketch C (collinear tip): (0,0,0)-(50,0,0) meets (50,0,0)-(100,0,0).
scripts.call: preTrim each; check split counts + id reuse.
scripts.expected: A: L1 splits 2 at (50,0,0); L2 NOT split, single [0,1], id REUSED (sourceId===splittedCurves[0].id). B: both [0,1] (mutual endpoint not interior). C: both [0,1] (shared endpoint only). Confirms endpoint-coincident intersections produce no cut; through-curve mid-hit does.
scripts.measurement: A L1 seg count + L2 id reuse; B,C both [0,1]

scripts.title: Degenerate overlaps (identical / partial collinear duplicate segment) + 3-4 curves through one point, no slivers
scripts.question: Identical fully-overlapping lines -> both [0,1] undetected (silent)? Partial collinear overlap -> each splits at the other's interior endpoint, DUPLICATING the overlap segment? 3-4 lines through one point -> each splits into exactly 2, no spurious slivers?

scripts.call: preTrim each; getPositions on all parts; detect zero-length slivers (start==end).

B: line1 cuts at x=40 (t~0.667), line2 at x=60 (t~0.333); overlap (40,0)->(60,0) DUPLICATED as both line1.seg2 and line2.seg1 (silent). C: each -> exactly 2 at (50,50,0), no extra cuts. D: each -> exactly 2. NO zero-length slivers anywhere (preTrim's auto points are dedup'd per curve, unlike splitCurve).
scripts.measurement: A both [0,1]; B cut params + duplicate-segment coords; C/D seg counts==2; sliver detector empty

scripts.title: Construction line and rigidSet member: [0,1] passthrough (no error) but STILL act as cutters; preTrim silent where splitCurve errors
scripts.question: Does a construction line (isConstruction:true) and a rigidSet member appear as [0,1] uncut (id===sourceId, no error/message) while STILL cutting normal curves they cross? rigidSet: splitCurve errors mL51, preTrim is silent — confirm the contrast.

B: both rigid members [0,1] uncut ids unchanged; the free line splits into 3 (crosses R1,R2 at two interior points); mL31, NO 'part of rigidset' error (splitCurve errors mL51 here — contrast). Non-trimmable = preserved-whole-but-still-cuts-others; detection only via id===sourceId, no diagnostic.

scripts.question: Does preTrim split AND the staging/restore round-trip work identically on a PLANELESS sketch (mL31)? Are postTrim-with-nothing-staged and trim-with-nothing-staged harmless no-ops (mL31)?
scripts.setup: addPlanelessSketch A: 2 crossed lines (dead solver). makeSketch B: 2 lines, call postTrim/trim BEFORE any preTrim.

B: postTrim no-preTrim -> mL31 no-op; trim no-preTrim -> mL31 silent no-op, geometry untouched.
scripts.measurement: A planeless cut coord + restored ids; B both no-ops mL31 + geometry unchanged
